notes.title: Patch Notes - Update 1.1.12.0
notes.notes:
Hello friends, we hope you’ve been enjoying the free Picture Perfect Update that was released today! In addition to some exciting new content, the update also comes with some more fixes to create an even smoother gameplay experience.

As always, thank you all for your patience and for continuing to share your feedback with us! 

[b]Update 1.1.12.0 includes the following fixes/changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a note on the Civic Restoration task, indicating that 'Renovate the Library' must be completed before proceeding. The quest marker for the library is still visible but can be untracked.

[*] Fixed issue where shops were unmanned after the centennial festival.

[*] Fixed bug where the release UI appeared after catching or releasing a fish.

[*] Corrected issue where shoreline patterns were visible in the middle of the ocean.

[*] Resolved bug where water sound effects were heard when using the net on the sand.

[*] Fixed issue where two ice birds were floating in the air.

[*] Debris is no longer visible after collection.

[*] Fixed bug where player clipped through the Dinghy during blueprint cutscene.

[*] Addressed issue where equipment and catch UI overlapped when both players were fishing in Co-Op mode. Now, gear can only be accessed if both players are not fishing.

[*] Boat collision with the middle of land in cloud zone fixed. Additionally, cloud areas around the edges are now properly adjusted.
[/list]

[b]Minor Fixes[/b]
Various collisions around the game world have been corrected to reduce possibilities of clipping out or falling through the terrain.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you encounter any further issues in-game, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us via the Steam Community Hub, social media, or [url=https://discord.gg/bunnyhug]Discord[/url]! Thank you and we hope you enjoy the new update!

notes.title: New Major Update 1.0.3 is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]New Major Update 1.0.3 brings mouse and rebindable keyboard and controller support to Moonglow Bay + much more.
[/h1]

Available from today, we’re really excited to roll out Moonglow Bay 1.0.3 to further address some of the concerns and issues you’ve been reporting.

Ever since we launched back on October 26, we’ve been listening intently to your feedback and working hard behind the scenes to refine, polish, and optimise Moonglow Bay to make the experience as good as it can be. 

Two of the biggest concerns we’ve heard from you is the lack of keyboard and mouse functionality and the option to remap your control scheme. With this update, we’re delighted to say that both are now possible!

1.0.3 also includes updates to the game’s UI, an improved cooking bar for the boiling minigame, as well as various character specific and gameplay tweaks and adjustments.

You can see the full changelog here…

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added mouse along with the existing keyboard controls
[*]Controller, and keyboard + mouse controls are now fully rebindable! It can be found  under the Options menu
[/list]
[h3]Main Menu / UI[/h3]
[list]
[*]Able to navigate menus using the D-pad
[*]Able to navigate shop UI with controller bumpers
[*]Expanded Options menu; More added to Audio and Graphics
[*]“Show/hide completed” preference in Task journal is saved permanently.
[*]Adjusted the page scrolling to carrousel through items
[*]Able to hold down to navigate sections of the journal and when adding or removing multiple items when selecting quantity
[*]Fixed an issue where hidden tasks remained hidden when there were no active tasks in the journal
[*]Improvements to the Boiling minigame
[*]Other minor updates to the UI
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*]Your boat, the Two Cats, can now be docked at the marina docks, by the Aquarium 
[*]You can’t enter the Two Cats anymore if it’s fully damaged
[*]The dinghy now moves even if the Two Cats is fully damaged 
[*]Players will no longer fall through the door of the cabin 
[*]No more soft blocking if attempting to assist while collecting fish from a net, during co-op
[*]Once the Two Cats is fixed, you can now board it at the Boat Shop
[*]Restaurateur achievement unlocks only when all requirements are reached
[*]Dinghy now won’t ever sink
[/list]

[h2]Spoilers Ahead![/h2]



[h3]Chapter 1:[/h3]
[list]
[*]If you return to town during the encounter with the Ruin of Ships, its soundtrack will no longer disappear forever
[*]River won’t get stuck when you save and quit during the lobster trap tutorial
[*]Lobster tutorial will now progress when starting it alongside the purchase of a boat upgrade
[/list]
[h3]Chapter 2:[/h3]
[list]
[*]When you open the Ocean Doors and you go to the Twintail Lake straight away, the Ouellette Twins will show at their correct location
[*]The dinghy’s acceleration won’t build up and shoot forward if the map is open or the game was paused while over water currents in the Hot Springs
[/list]
[h3]Chapter 4:[/h3]
[list]
[*]No longer able to enter the Crystal Squid’s den before its encounter 
[*]The Crystal Squid will now release the trash piles during co-op as well
[/list]
[h3]Chapter 5:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fishing line no longer snaps immediately in the Astral Planes while casting to the furthest distance possible 
[*]The Two Cats won’t fly in the sky anymore
[/list]
[h3]Help! I'm Stuck[/h3]
Option of "Help! I'm Stuck" no longer available in the following situations:
[list]
[*]Before answering the door to River
[*]Before getting the journal
[*]During the trash clean up task
[*]During fishing tutorial with River
[*]Before the ice fishing tutorial
[*]During the Crystal Squid encounter
[/list]

We know our Xbox / Game Pass players are still waiting patiently for more updates and those are still being worked on and are forthcoming. Please stay tuned to our social media channels for all the latest news. 

We’ve been overwhelmed by the ‘Very Positive’ Steam review sentiment over the past 30 days and are delighted to see many of the issues you’ve cited have been addressed. We hope this patch will go a step further in making the experience even better for everyone. 

If you haven’t already, and are having a great time in Moonglow Bay, we’d really appreciate it if you could leave a review on Steam to tell us more about your experiences. 

Thank you so much for all your messages and support over the past two months. We sincerely apologise for any issues you may have experienced while playing the game and we truly hope this update provides the level of support you’ve been looking for.

notes.title: Help, I've been playing cozy fishing game Moonglow Bay for 7 straight hours
notes.notes: The quaint fishing town of Moonglow Bay has fallen on hard times. The streets, beaches, and even the bay itself are littered with trash. Shops are closed, buildings are falling apart, and the mayor is literally nailing boards across the door of city hall, ready to call it quits. It's all due to the fishing industry, which has become nonexistent since rumors and sightings of a terrifying sea monster began to circulate and local fisherpeople became too scared to take their boats out into the bay... Read more.

notes.title: Moonglow Bay is available now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171056/4d112e4cec135153b4d2b77d4752c7e20f79b735.jpg[/img]

Well guppy, it’s finally time! Publisher Coatsink and Developer Bunnyhug are delighted to reveal that Moonglow Bay is available from today on Steam. 

The game will cost £19.99/$24.99 USD/€24.99 SRP across all territories.

[previewyoutube=Kho6ChuE8Cc;full][/previewyoutube]

Moonglow Bay has been in development for four years, from concept stage through to its launch today. Bunnyhug and Coatsink have collaborated on the project every step of the way and we’re so excited to see where your journey will take you.

In Moonglow Bay, there’s various types of fishing - whether you’re using a net or trap - but in order to get the tourist trade flourishing again you’ll need to renovate broken down buildings, establish your startup street food business, and build lasting relationships to unite the townsfolk ahead of its centennial celebrations.

You’ll cook recipes to unlock new ones, earn shells by fulfilling requests from the community, gain different rod types and bait to catch even more unique aquatic species. You’ll even be able to purchase upgrades to your equipment, such as more spacious storage for your meals and a portable kitchen on your boat.

And did we mention the entire game is playable in local co-op? There’s so much to see and do in Moonglow Bay that having a little help can go a long way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171056/7689cdb57bb48e11d017103c850a5aa7ff68a26f.jpg[/img]

During launch, we’re also raising money for Ocean Clean Up as part of Coatsink10K. Within the Bay, you’ll find lots of debris and waste and this is reflective of a real world problem. Plastic pollution in the world’s oceans is one of the biggest environmental issues of our time, impacting nearly 700 marine species. 

Moonglow Bay gives you the opportunity to discover fascinating forms of marine life: fish, squid, sharks, learning more about them. They are all part of an important eco-system and we are at risk of losing many of them.

This is a cause near and dear to all of our hearts and we would really appreciate any support you can provide to help protect these amazing creatures.

[url=https://www.justgiving.com/fundraising/coatsink10-ocean-cleanup]https://www.justgiving.com/fundraising/coatsink10-ocean-cleanup[/url]

It’s been an absolute pleasure sharing the unique types of fish with you every Friday, as well as some of the delicious dishes you’ll be able to make through Bay Bites. 

From all of us here at Coatsink, we hope you have an incredible time exploring Moonglow Bay. Be sure to tell us what you think on social media and let us know if you’re streaming as we may drop by from time to time. 

Welcome home!

notes.title: Moonglow Bay review: a relaxing fishing RPG that's all about keeping it reel
notes.notes:
Everything in the seaside town of Moonglow Bay has seen better days. That includes you, a middle-aged accountant who’s moved out of the big city for a fresh start. But things never go quite to plan, do they? The moment-to-moment of Moonglow Bay is a chilled-out experience of getting out onto the waves, exploring various biomes, catching fish, and cooking them up to sell or gift to the townspeople. But within that is an exploration of things going awry, and letting go of old dreams in order to build new ones.

Read more

notes.title: Moonglow Bay setting sail later than expected on October 26, 2021
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171056/c706df3499674d610c9148f01555df6952e51af7.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Moonglow Bay setting sail later than expected on October 26, 2021.[/b][/h2]

Publisher Coatsink and developers Bunnyhug are unfortunately announcing Moonglow Bay, the story-driven ‘slice-of-life' fishing RPG will be departing the bay a little later than expected due to additional development time needed to ensure the best possible experience.  

Originally planned to release October 7th, Moonglow Bay will now be setting sail on [b]October 26th 2021[/b].

[previewyoutube=EpKl2ETxnY4;full][/previewyoutube]

The team have been building an enriching world full of things to see and do, and from day one the intention was always to create an experience that is lasting, making Moonglow Bay the absolute best place to visit. In order to truly deliver on that vision, it has been determined that we need to shift our launch date.

However, we still want to share more of Moonglow Bay before release day so we’ll have something new to show you on October 7th. Please look out for it across our [url=https://twitter.com/MoonglowBay]social channels[/url]!

[i]“The game is delayed, but not by much!

We at Bunnyhug have been working on Moonglow Bay for 4 years alongside Coatsink to make the best experience possible.

Sadly, over the last few weeks we’ve been encountering some pesky bugs which have made getting a clean release build difficult.

The game is now in a good place and in the final stage of development, but still needs to pass the final hurdles, so to ensure all is right as rain, we’ll be releasing Moonglow Bay on October 26! 

We hope you can enjoy what’s coming!”  -  The Bunnyhug team [/i]

The community that has grown around our game make us smile and laugh every day. You’ve given us all the motivation to deliver something truly special and we are ever grateful for your support

While we appreciate this news will be disappointing to hear, we hope you’ll still embark on this journey with us in just a few weeks time.

Bunnyhug and Coatsink

notes.title: Moonglow Bay opens for business from October 7th
notes.notes:
As announced during the Future Games Show, Coatsink and Bunnyhug are thrilled to announce that Moonglow Bay will welcome visitors on Steam from October 7th for [b]£19.99/$24.99 USD/€24.99 SRP - Wishlists are now open![/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7z6NcJeqAbM

Moonglow Bay is set along the Eastern Canadian coastline in a fishing town afraid to fish. The Bay was once considered a tourist attraction until rumours of dangerous, fantastical creatures ruined the trade. 
With the town on the verge of bankruptcy and only one year until its centennial, you decide to fulfil your partner’s final wish of starting a business in a decisive attempt to revive the town.

Along the way you will befriend locals and encounter strange fish, cook and sell a variety of recipes; acquire new equipment, such as rods and a fishing boat; learn to cast nets, set traps and fish through ice. 
Explore the furthest reaches of the bay, from frigid glaciers to boiling geysers; and ultimately determine if there is any truth to the tales…

[i]Do magical creatures really exist in Moonglow Bay?
[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171056/3c8b66b4e7f10e27c6adf0c9b70dcc0f2ece1f26.jpg[/img]

Moonglow Bay combines a playful voxel art style and a sumptuous soundtrack, featuring distinct story arcs, 100+ aquatic species to discover, Monster encounters and a fully-inhabited town to explore, which can be enjoyed both single-player or with drop-in-drop-out local co-op.
 
For all the latest news, visit our website moonglowbay.com or follow us on Twitter @MoonglowBay 
 
For now, we’ll leave you with a first look at the Glacier Biome, one of several areas you’ll get to visit during your adventures.
 
We’ll sea you on October 7th!

notes.title: Moonglow Bay will (catch and) release its chill voxel fish on October 7th
notes.notes:
I recently learned about goblincore, a cottagecore-adjacent aesthetic that's a little more rooted in fantasy and dirt than its pastoral cousin.

Since we're defining niches, you can't convince me to not call Moonglow Bay fishcore. It's got the little seaside house, the pet, the Instagram-ready book-and-an-armchair scenes, but it's also about sailing out on your little tug to catch different kinds of fish. And you can't convince me that boat doesn't smell of fish guts.

There's a new trailer below, which brings the news that we can all imagine those fish guts come October 7th.
